THE ORDER By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3.of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, that have to be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President do by this order declare the Achchankulam Mangrove Forest of 1405.79 hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the schedule hereto as Achchankulam Mangrove Reserved Forest from 12th day of October, 2019. MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA, President. 12th day of October, 2019, Polonnaruwa.
